SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME AS DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, KEY_3 AS REVISION FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'QTHDDOWN' AND TARGET IN ( 'KRXPR00796' ) AND KEY_9 IN ('E') GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '01' AS PLANT, NVL(A.QUOTATION_NO ,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(A.QUOTATION_SEQ ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(A.REVISION , 0) AS REVISION_NO, NVL(A.STATUS ,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.DESCRIPTION ,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION ,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(A.UNIT_MEASURE ,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(A.MAKER_NAME ,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT NVL(T.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') FROM XPROCQSP T WHERE T.BUYER = A.BUYER AND T.STDCATLG_ID = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS ITEM_NO, '1' AS IF_FLAG, NVL(ATOB_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS IF_DATE, NVL(ATOB_TIME,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS')) AS IF_TIME FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_9 IN ('E')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'D', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_9 IN ('E')
